title: Arabian Nights
author: Anonymous
description: 《一千零一夜》（又名《天方夜谭》）是阿拉伯民间故事集锦，代表了古代中东文学的至高成就。故事缘起于波斯国王沙赫里亚尔因王后背叛而对所有女性产生仇恨，每日娶一女子，次日晨即杀之。宰相的聪慧女儿雪赫拉查德为了拯救无辜女性，毅然自愿嫁给国王。每晚她为国王讲一个极其吸引人的精彩故事，并在最扣人心弦的高潮处停下，使国王因渴望听完故事而不断推迟处决。经过一千零一夜的智慧讲述，国王彻底被感动与感化，最终废除虐杀暴行，与雪赫拉查德白头偕老。

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Sultan and Scheherazade’s Courage
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 1 章：国王的虐杀与雪赫拉查德的勇毅

paragraphs.en: In ancient times, in the royal city of Samarkand, ruled a powerful Persian monarch named Sultan Shahryar. He was initially a wise and benevolent ruler, beloved by all his subjects. However, when he discovered that his beloved queen had been unfaithful, his heart turned to cold iron, and his mind was consumed by a bitter, dark madness. Convincing himself that no woman on earth could ever be trusted, he swore a bloodthirsty oath of vengeance.
paragraphs.zh: 在古代，在撒马尔罕的皇家城市里，统治着一位名叫沙赫里亚尔苏丹的强大波斯君主。他最初是一位明智而仁慈的统治者，受到所有臣民的喜爱。然而，当他发现自己亲爱的王后背叛了他时，他的心变成了冰冷的铁石，头脑被痛苦而黑暗的疯狂所吞噬。他确信世上没有任何女性值得信任，发下了嗜血的复仇誓言。

paragraphs.en: Every evening, the Sultan ordered his Grand Vizier to bring him a fresh young maiden from the city as his bride. The next morning at dawn, driven by his cruel vow, the Sultan commanded the executioner to behead the innocent bride. For three long years, terror gripped the city; families wept in agony, and mothers fled with their daughters, leaving the kingdom desolate and haunted by constant mourning.
paragraphs.zh: 每天晚上，苏丹命令他的大宰相从城里带回一位新鲜的年轻少女作为他的新娘。第二天清晨，在残酷誓言的驱使下，苏丹命令刽子手将无辜的新娘斩首。在长达三年的时间里，恐怖笼罩着整座城市；家庭在痛苦中哭泣，母亲们带着女儿逃跑，使王国变得荒凉且充斥着不断的哀悼。

paragraphs.en: The Grand Vizier had two daughters, the elder of whom was named Scheherazade, a young woman of rare beauty, courage, and matchless wisdom. She had read thousands of books on history, philosophy, poetry, and medicine, storing in her memory the tales of ancient kings and sages. Seeing the sorrow of her people, Scheherazade resolved to perform a perilous deed: 'Father,' she declared calmly, 'I entreat you by all that is sacred to present me to the Sultan as his bride.'
paragraphs.zh: 大宰存有两个女儿，长女名叫雪赫拉查德，是一位有着罕见美貌、勇气和无可比拟智慧的年轻女子。她阅读过数千本关于历史、哲学、诗歌和医学的书籍，在记忆中储存了古代国王和贤哲的故事。看到人民的悲伤，雪赫拉查德决心实施一项危险的壮举：“父亲，”她平静地宣布，“我以一切神圣的名义恳求您将我献给苏丹作为他的新娘。”

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Story of the Merchant and the Jinnee
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 2 章：商人与巨精的故事

paragraphs.en: On her first night, Scheherazade began the story of a rich Merchant who sat down under a palm tree to eat dates, throwing the date stones right and left. Suddenly, a giant Jinnee of monstrous size appeared before him with a drawn sword, roaring: 'Rise, that I may kill thee with this sword, as thou hast killed my son!' The merchant cried out: 'How could I have killed your son?' 'When thou didst throw away date stones,' replied the Jinnee, 'one struck my son in the eye and killed him instantly.'
paragraphs.zh: 在她入宫的第一夜，雪赫拉查德开始讲述一个富商的故事，他坐在棕榈树下吃椰枣，左右乱扔枣核。突然，一个体型巨大的巨精手里举着拔出的剑出现在他面前，咆哮道：“站起来，以便我用这把剑杀死你，就像你杀死了我的儿子一样！”商人喊道：“我怎么可能杀了你的儿子？”“当你扔掉枣核时，”巨精回答，“其中一颗打中了我的儿子的眼睛，立刻要了他的命。”

paragraphs.en: The poor merchant begged for mercy, asking for a one-year reprieve to settle his affairs, distribute his wealth among his wife and children, and return to meet his death. Moved by the merchant's absolute honesty, the Jinnee granted his request. One year later, the faithful merchant returned to the palm tree, awaiting his doom. Three old men passed by, and hearing the merchant's tale, offered to tell the Jinnee three marvelous stories in exchange for his life. The Jinnee was so amazed by their tales that he spared the honest merchant.
paragraphs.zh: 可怜的商人恳求慈悲，要求一年的缓刑来处理他的事务，在妻子和孩子们中间分发财产，并回来接受死亡。被商人绝对的诚实所打动，巨精满足了他的请求。一年后，忠诚的商人回到了棕榈树下，等待着他的厄运。三个老人经过，听到商人的故事，提出向巨精讲述三个神奇的故事来换取他的生命。巨精被他们的故事所震撼，饶了这位诚实的商人。

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves - The Magic Cave
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 3 章：阿里巴巴与神奇山洞

paragraphs.en: Scheherazade then began the tale of Ali Baba, a poor woodcutter living in a Persian town. One afternoon, while gathering firewood in the forest, he heard the thunderous sound of forty heavily armed bandits riding up to a sheer stone mountain wall. The captain stepped forward and shouted: 'Open, Sesame!' A hidden stone door swung open, revealing a cavern filled with mountain loads of stolen gold and jewels.
paragraphs.zh: 雪赫拉查德接着开始讲述阿里巴巴的故事，一个住在波斯小镇上的贫穷柴夫。一天下午，当他在森林里收集柴火时，他听到了四十个装备精良的大盗骑马停在一座陡峭石山墙前的雷鸣般声音。头子走上前去喊道：“芝麻开门！”一道隐藏的石门轰然打开，露出了一座填满堆积如山偷来黄金与珠宝的山洞。

paragraphs.en: Once the robbers left, Ali Baba repeated the magic words: 'Open, Sesame!' The cave opened, and Ali Baba loaded his donkeys with gold coins, driving them home. He shared the secret with his wife and his clever slave girl, Morgiana. However, Ali Baba's greedy brother Kasim learned the secret, entered the cave alone, and in his greed forgot the magic words, shouting 'Open, Barley!' Kasim was trapped inside and slain by the returning thieves.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦强盗们离开，阿里巴巴重复了魔咒：“芝麻开门！”山洞打开了，阿里巴巴用金币装满他的驴子赶回家。他与妻子和他聪慧的女奴摩尔佳娜分享了秘密。然而，阿里巴巴贪婪的大哥卡西姆得知了秘密，单独进入山洞，并在贪婪中忘记了魔咒，喊成了“大麦开门！”卡西姆被困在里面并被返回的大盗杀害。

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Morgiana and the Forty Thieves' Defeat
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 4 章：摩尔佳娜之智与强盗覆灭

paragraphs.en: Finding Kasim's body missing, the forty thieves realized someone else knew their secret. The robber captain disguised himself as an oil merchant and brought thirty-nine oil jars to Ali Baba's house, inside thirty-eight of which thieves were hidden alive! But the clever Morgiana discovered the plot while seeking oil for her lamp. She boiled a huge cauldron of oil and poured it into the jars, killing the hidden bandits.
paragraphs.zh: 发现卡西姆的尸体失踪，四十大盗意识到还有其他人知道他们的秘密。强盗头子伪装成石油商人，带着三十九个油罐来到阿里巴巴家，里面活活藏着三十八个强盗！但聪慧的摩尔佳娜在为她的灯寻找石油时发现了这个阴谋。她煮沸了一大锅油倒入油罐中，杀死了隐藏的大盗。

paragraphs.en: Later, the captain entered Ali Baba's house disguised as a merchant to seek revenge. During a banquet, Morgiana performed a graceful dagger dance, and with a swift thrust, stabbed the robber captain to the heart, saving Ali Baba's life. Deeply grateful, Ali Baba freed Morgiana and married her to his son.
paragraphs.zh: 后来，强盗头子伪装成商人进入阿里巴巴家寻仇。在一次宴会上，摩尔佳娜表演了优雅的匕首舞，并迅速一刺，刺中了强盗头子心脏，救了阿里巴巴的命。无比感激的阿里巴巴释放了摩尔佳娜，并将她嫁给了自己的儿子。

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp - The Magic Ring
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 5 章：阿拉丁与神灯手环

paragraphs.en: Scheherazade next wove the magical tale of Aladdin, a poor boy living in China. An evil magician from North Africa pretended to be Aladdin's uncle and led him to a secret underground cave. Giving Aladdin a magic ring for protection, the sorcerer ordered him to retrieve an old brass oil lamp. But when Aladdin refused to hand over the lamp before climbing out, the angry magician sealed the cave.
paragraphs.zh: 雪赫拉查德接下来编织了阿拉丁的神奇故事，一个生活在中国贫穷男孩。一个来自北非的邪恶巫师假装是阿拉丁的叔叔，带他来到了一个秘密地下山洞。给了阿拉丁一枚魔法手环作为保护，巫师命令他取回一盏旧黄铜油灯。但当阿拉丁在爬出来前拒绝交出油灯时，愤怒的巫师封死了山洞。

paragraphs.en: Trapped in the dark, Aladdin accidentally rubbed the magic ring. A giant Genie of the Ring appeared, bellowing: 'I am the slave of the ring! What is your command?' The Genie transported Aladdin safely home to his mother.
paragraphs.zh: 被困在黑暗中，阿拉丁意外擦拭了魔法手环。一个巨大的手环精灵出现了，咆哮道：“我是手环的奴隶！您有什么指令？”精灵把阿拉丁安全传送回到了他母亲身边。

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Aladdin's Palace and the Sorcerer's Revenge
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 6 章：阿拉丁的水晶城堡与巫师复仇

paragraphs.en: When Aladdin's mother rubbed the brass lamp to clean it, a colossal Genie of the Lamp burst forth, capable of fulfilling any wish. With the Genie's unlimited power, Aladdin acquired boundless gold, built a magnificent crystal palace, and married Princess Badroulbadour, the Sultan's daughter.
paragraphs.zh: 当阿拉丁的母亲擦拭黄铜油灯来清理它时，一个巨型油灯精灵喷涌而出，能够满足任何愿望。利用精灵无限的力量，阿拉丁获得了无尽的黄金，建造了一座宏伟的水晶城堡，并娶了巴德鲁巴杜尔公主（苏丹的女儿）。

paragraphs.en: However, the evil magician returned in disguise, crying 'New lamps for old!' and tricked the Princess into trading the magic lamp. The sorcerer transported the palace and the Princess to Africa. But Aladdin used his magic ring to travel to Africa, slayed the sorcerer, recovered the lamp, and brought his palace and bride safely home.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，邪恶的巫师伪装归来，喊着“以旧灯换新灯！”，诱骗公主换走了魔法油灯。巫师将城堡和公主传送到了非洲。但阿拉丁利用他的魔法手环前往非洲，杀死了巫师，收复了油灯，并将他的城堡和新娘安全带回了家。

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Sinbad the Sailor and the Valley of Diamonds
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 7 章：水手辛巴达与钻石之谷

paragraphs.en: Scheherazade also recounted the legendary voyages of Sinbad the Sailor. On his second voyage, Sinbad was accidentally marooned on a desert island. He tied himself with his turban to the leg of a giant Roc bird, which carried him across the sea to a deep valley paved with sparkling diamonds, but guarded by giant serpents.
paragraphs.zh: 雪赫拉查德还讲述了水手辛巴达的传奇航行。在他第二次航行中，辛巴达意外被抛弃在了荒岛上。他用头巾把自己系在一只巨型大鹏鸟的腿上，大鹏带着他飞越海洋来到了一个铺满闪烁钻石、但由巨蛇守护的深谷。

paragraphs.en: Sinbad strapped a chunk of raw meat to his back. A giant eagle scooped him up along with the meat and carried him to its nest, where diamond merchants rescued him. Returning to Baghdad with immense wealth in diamonds, Sinbad shared his riches generously with the poor.
paragraphs.zh: 辛巴达在背上系了一大块生肉。一只巨鹰把他和肉一起舀起来带到了巢穴里，商人们在那里拯救了他。带着装满钻石的巨额财富回到巴格达，辛巴达慷慨地与穷人分享了他的财富。

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Triumph of Wisdom and Eternal Peace
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 8 章：智慧的胜利与永恒和平（终极结局）

paragraphs.en: For one thousand and one nights, Scheherazade continued her enchanted storytelling. She filled the Sultan's heart with tales of valiant knights, tragic lovers, wise caliphs, magical jinn, and distant magical lands. Through these stories, she subtly taught the Sultan lessons of justice, compassion, forgiveness, and the noble beauty of mercy.
paragraphs.zh: 在一千零一夜里，雪赫拉查德继续着她迷人的故事讲述。她用英勇骑士、悲剧恋人、明智哈里发、魔法精灵与远方奇幻土地的故事填满了苏丹的心。通过这些故事，她微妙地教导了苏丹关于正义、同情、原谅以及慈悲的高尚美德。

paragraphs.en: On the thousand and first night, having finished her story, Scheherazade presented her three small sons to the Sultan, begging for her life for their sake. Tears of joy streamed down Sultan Shahryar's face as he embraced her tenderly, declaring that her profound wisdom and virtue had healed his soul. The Sultan abolished his cruel laws forever, and lived with Scheherazade in love and peace.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一千零一夜，讲完她的故事后，雪赫拉查德将她的三个小儿子呈现在苏丹面前，为了他们恳求饶命。喜悦的眼泪沿着沙赫里亚尔苏丹的面颊流下，他温柔地拥抱了她，宣布她深刻的智慧与美德治愈了他的灵魂。苏丹永远废除了他的残酷法律，并与雪赫拉查德生活在爱与和平之中。
